1-UNITNING UCHINCHI BETI (8-bet). Oq fon.

Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq yorliqda katta oq '1' va yonida 'People around the World'; ostida gorizontal chiziq.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq harflar bilan 'Language Development' sarlavhasi.
9) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: ancient, cultural, delicate, friendly, holiday, rich, sandy, strong, tropical, wooden. Ostida 10 ta nuqtali qator: 1 a(n) ... culture; 2 a(n) ... climate; 3 ... beaches; 4 ... temples; 5 a(n) ... destination; 6 ... features; 7 ... people; 8 ... wills; 9 ... houses; 10 ...history
10) 'Fill in:' well known, typical, celebrate, generous, spicy, includes. Oltita gap.
11) 'Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Besh ibora bir xatboshida.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking' sarlavhasi: 'Read the article in Ex. 8 again and take notes under these headings. Then, look at your notes and talk about Thailand and its people.' Ikki ustunli ko'k ro'yxat: Place, Location, Features; People (Looks, Character); Dwellings; Jobs; Food; Free-time Activities

O'NG USTUN:
12) 'Choose words from the table and describe your classmates.' Och ko'k jadval, chap ustunda toifalar (general appearance, age, height, build, eyes, hair, other features), o'ngda so'zlar.
13) 'GAME: Choose one of your classmates. The rest of the class ask questions to find out who the person is, as in the example.' Ikki ustunli ko'k qiya namuna dialog (S1-S4 va L).
14) 'Match the adjectives to the reasons, then use them to describe people you know well, as in the example.' Chapda 8 sifat, o'ngda 8 sabab; 'honest' dan 'never tell lies' ga ko'k STRELKA chizilgan. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna: 'Tom is very honest. He never tells lies.'
15) (kassetа belgisi bilan) a) 'Listen and cross out the adjective which does not match the colour.' Pushti ramkada jadval: 'YOUR FAVOURITE COLOUR & YOUR CHARACTER' - har rang o'z rangidagi bo'yoq dog'i shaklida: red, blue, green, black, purple, yellow, white; har birining yonida uchta sifat.
   b) 'Ask your friend what his/her favourite colour is, then use the table on the left to talk about his/her character, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya namuna.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': ikkita savol.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '8'.

⚠ 15a mashqining javobi FAQAT AUDIODA - qaysi sifat mos kelmasligini yozuvsiz aniqlab bo'lmaydi.

exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA 7-BETDAGI MATNDA BOR.

  ⚠ Bu - COLLOCATION mashqi: qaysi sifat
  qaysi ot bilan BIRGA yuradi.

  ⚠ Kirish betida (5-bet) aytilgan edi:
  'A particular feature of the book is the
  teaching of COLLOCATIONS.'


⚠ NIMA UChUN 'a(n)' FAQAT BA'ZILARIDA:

  1, 2, 5-bandlarda 'a(n)' bor -
  demak ot BIRLIKDA va SANALADIGAN.

  Qolganlarida artikl yo'q:
     • ko'plik (beaches, temples,
       features, people, wills, houses)
     • sanalmaydigan (history)

  ⚠ 'a' yoki 'an' - keyingi so'zning
  TOVUShIGA qarab:
     a rich culture      (r - undosh)
     an ancient temple   (a - unli)


⚠ HAR IBORANING MA'NOSI:

  a rich culture      - boy madaniyat
  a tropical climate  - tropik iqlim
  sandy beaches       - qumli plyajlar
  ancient temples     - qadimiy ibodatxonalar
  a holiday destination - ta'til manzili
  delicate features   - nozik yuz tuzilishi
  friendly people     - samimiy odamlar
  strong wills        - kuchli iroda
  wooden houses       - yog'och uylar
  cultural history    - madaniy tarix

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: well known, typical, celebrate, generous, spicy, includes.
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'ying: well known, typical, celebrate, generous, spicy, includes.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLARNI YANGI GAPDA QO'LLASh.

  ⚠ Hamma so'z 7-betdagi matnda bor edi,
  lekin bu yerda BOShQA mamlakatlar
  haqida gapiriladi. Bu - 'transfer':
  o'rganilgan so'zni yangi vaziyatda
  ishlatish.


⚠ MILLAT NOMLARI - 'THE' BILAN:

  The Japanese ARE ...
  The Spanish ...

  ⚠ 'the' + millat sifati = butun xalq.
  ⚠ Fe'l KO'PLIKDA bo'ladi ('are', 'like').

  ⚠ -ese va -sh bilan tugaydigan millatlar
  ko'plikda O'ZGARMAYDI:
     the Japanese, the Chinese,
     the Spanish, the British, the English

  ⚠ Boshqalari -s oladi:
     Indians, Americans, Italians
     (Bandlarda: 'Indian people' -
     'people' bilan ham aytish mumkin.)


⚠ QAYSI SO'Z QAYSI BANDGA:

  1  well known - 'be well known FOR'
     iborasi (11-mashqda ham bor)
  2  generous - xarakter sifati
  3  typical - 'odatiy'
  4  spicy - ovqat sifati
  5  includes - fe'l, 3-shaxs -S bilan
  6  celebrate - fe'l, 'the Spanish'
     ko'plik, shuning uchun -S YO'Q

  ⚠ 5 va 6-bandlarga DIQQAT:
     'The guidebook includeS' (birlik)
     'The Spanish celebrate' (ko'plik)

items.sentence: The Japanese are ___ for their hospitality.
Ann's ___ nature makes her very special to everyone.
items.uz: Annning saxovatli tabiati uni hamma uchun juda alohida qiladi.

items.sentence: A ___ Italian meal consists of pasta, meat and salad.
items.uz: Odatiy italyan ovqati makaron, go'sht va salatdan iborat.

items.sentence: The guidebook ___ information on hotels and trains.
items.uz: Yo'lboshchi kitob mehmonxona va poyezdlar haqida ma'lumotni o'z ichiga oladi.

items.sentence: The Spanish ___ a lot of festivals every year.
items.uz: Ispanlar har yili ko'plab bayramlarni nishonlaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLI IBORALAR.

  ⚠ Predlogni MANTIQ bilan topib bo'lmaydi -
  ular fe'l/sifat bilan BIRGA yodlanadi.

  ⚠ Hamma ibora 7-betdagi matnda bor edi.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to have sth IN common
     = umumiy narsaga ega bo'lmoq
     'We have a lot in common.'

  to be proud OF sb/sth
     = ... dan faxrlanmoq
     'I am proud of my son.'

  to live IN a village
     = qishloqda yashamoq
     ⚠ 'in a village', 'in a city',
     lekin 'ON a farm', 'AT home'

  to consist OF sth
     = ... dan iborat bo'lmoq
     ⚠ 'consist' HECh QAChON continuous
     shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

  to be well known FOR sth
     = ... bilan mashhur bo'lmoq
     ⚠ 'for' PREDLOG, shuning uchun
     keyin -ING: 'well known for BEING
     generous'.


⚠ 'FOR' va 'AS' FARQI:

  well known FOR sth = nimasi bilan
     mashhur (sabab)
  known AS sth = qanday nom bilan
     tanilgan

  'He is well known FOR his songs.'
  'He is known AS the King of Pop.'

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'in common' - turg'un ibora.
'We have a lot IN common.'

⚠ 'proud OF' - HAR DOIM 'of'.
Matnda: 'proud of our history'.

⚠ 'IN a village/city/town'.
Lekin 'ON a farm', 'AT home'.

⚠ 'consist OF' - HAR DOIM 'of'.
⚠ Continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

⚠ 'known FOR' = nimasi bilan mashhur.
⚠ 'known AS' = qanday nom bilan tanilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the table and describe your classmates.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvaldan so'zlarni tanlang va sinfdoshlaringizni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TASHQI QIYOFA JADVALI.

  ⚠ Bu jadval butun unit davomida kerak
  bo'ladi - uni yaxshi yodlang.


⚠ TASVIRLASh TARTIBI (jadval tartibi):

  1) umumiy ko'rinish
  2) yosh
  3) bo'y
  4) gavda
  5) ko'z
  6) soch
  7) boshqa belgilar

  Namuna:
  'She is a pretty young woman. She is
   tall and slim with big green eyes and
   long curly fair hair. She has got a
   friendly smile.'


⚠ EHTIYoT BO'LING - QO'POL SO'ZLAR:

  ugly (xunuk), fat (semiz), plain
  (oddiy, chiroysiz) - bu so'zlar
  ODAMNI XAFA QILADI.

  ⚠ Odob bilan:
     fat  → a bit overweight, plump
     ugly → not very attractive


⚠ 'FAIR' va 'BLONDE':

  'fair hair' = oq-sariq soch
  'blonde' - asosan ayol uchun.


⚠ 'HEIGHT' va 'BUILD' FARQI:

  height = BO'Y (tall, short)
  build  = GAVDA (slim, well-built)

  ⚠ 'of medium height' = o'rtacha bo'yli
  ⚠ 'of medium build' = o'rtacha gavdali
  Ikkalasi ham 'of' bilan!

points.en: general appearance: handsome, good-looking, pretty, attractive, beautiful, plain, ugly
points.uz: umumiy ko'rinish: kelishgan, chiroyli, go'zal, jozibali, sohibjamol, oddiy, xunuk
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'handsome' - ERKAK uchun.
⚠ 'pretty', 'beautiful' - AYoL uchun.
⚠ 'good-looking', 'attractive' - ikkalasi uchun.

⚠ 'plain' va 'ugly' QO'POL - ehtiyot bo'ling.

points.en: age: young, middle-aged, old, in his early/mid-/late thirties
points.uz: yosh: yosh, o'rta yoshli, keksa, o'ttiz yoshlarning boshida/o'rtasida/oxirida
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'middle-aged' = o'rta yoshli (40-60).
⚠ 'old' o'rniga odob bilan 'elderly' deyiladi.

⚠ early (0-3) / mid- (4-6) / late (7-9).

points.en: height: tall, short, of medium height
points.uz: bo'y: baland bo'yli, past bo'yli, o'rtacha bo'yli
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'height' = BO'Y ('high' so'zidan).
⚠ 'of medium height' - 'of' bilan.

⚠ Talaffuzi: 'hayt' ('heyt' emas).

points.en: build: fat, plump, well-built, slim, thin, of medium build
points.uz: gavda: semiz, to'ladan kelgan, baquvvat, nozik, ozg'in, o'rtacha gavdali
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'fat' QO'POL. Odob bilan: 'plump' yoki
'a bit overweight'.

⚠ 'slim' - MAQTOV (nozik, kelishgan).
⚠ 'thin' - betaraf yoki salbiy (ozg'in).

points.en: eyes: green, blue, grey, big, small
points.uz: ko'zlar: yashil, ko'k, kulrang, katta, kichik
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'eyes' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA tasvirlanadi:
'She has got big blue eyeS.'

⚠ Tartib: KATTALIK → RANG:
'big blue eyes' ('blue big' EMAS).

points.en: hair: short, long, wavy, curly, straight, fair, light/dark brown
points.uz: soch: kalta, uzun, to'lqinsimon, jingalak, tekis, oq-sariq, och/to'q jigarrang
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'hair' SANALMAYDIGAN - HAR DOIM BIRLIKDA:
'She has got long hair' ('hairs' EMAS).

⚠ Tartib: UZUNLIK → ShAKL → RANG:
'long curly fair hair'.

points.en: other features: beard, moustache, glasses, broad shoulders, full lips, friendly smile, dark/light complexion, bald, wrinkles, freckles
points.uz: boshqa belgilar: soqol, mo'ylov, ko'zoynak, keng yelka, to'la lablar, samimiy tabassum, to'q/och yuz rangi, kal, ajinlar, sepkillar
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'glasses' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA (qaychi kabi).
⚠ 'shoulders', 'lips', 'wrinkles', 'freckles' -
tabiiy ravishda ko'plikda.

⚠ 'freckles' = sepkil (yuzdagi mayda dog'lar).

exercises.instructionEn: GAME: Choose one of your classmates. The rest of the class ask questions to find out who the person is, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: O'YIN: Sinfdoshlaringizdan birini tanlang. Sinfning qolgan qismi kim ekanini topish uchun savol beradi, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
TOPISH O'YINI - HA/YO'Q SAVOLLARI.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  S1: Is it a male?
  L:  Yes, he is.
  S2: Is he ...?
  L:  No, he isn't.
  S3: Has he got ...?
  L:  Yes, he has.
  S4: Is it ...?
  L:  Yes, you're right, it is ...

  ⚠ 'L' = Leader (o'yinni boshqaruvchi).


⚠ QISQA JAVOB QOLIPI:

  Savol 'Is ...?' bilan boshlansa →
     'Yes, he IS.' / 'No, he ISN'T.'

  Savol 'Has ... got?' bilan boshlansa →
     'Yes, he HAS.' / 'No, he HASN'T.'

  ⚠ Qisqa javobda SAVOLDAGI FE'L
  takrorlanadi - boshqa fe'l EMAS.

  ⚠ 'Yes, he is.' - to'liq shakl.
     'Yes, he's.' - XATO! Tasdiqda
     qisqartma ishlatilmaydi.


⚠ 'A MALE' va 'A FEMALE':

  a male   = erkak jinsi
  a female = ayol jinsi

  ⚠ Bu - RASMIY/ILMIY so'zlar
  (hujjatlarda, anketalarda).
  Oddiy nutqda 'a man' / 'a woman'.


⚠ 'IS IT' va 'IS HE':

  Boshida kim ekani NOMA'LUM →
     'IS IT a male?'
  Jinsi ma'lum bo'lgach →
     'IS HE tall?'

items.question: Is it a male?
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi namuna.

⚠ Boshida 'IT', javobda esa jinsi ma'lum
bo'lgani uchun 'HE'.

items.question: Has he got a beard?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'Has ... got?' → 'Yes, he HAS.'
'Yes, he has got' deyish ham mumkin, lekin
qisqasi tabiiyroq.

items.question: Is it Tom?
items.answer: Yes, you're right, it is Tom.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Ism aytilganda yana 'IT' ishlatiladi:
'Is IT Tom?'

exercises.instructionEn: Match the adjectives to the reasons, then use them to describe people you know well, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarni sabablarga moslang, so'ng ular bilan yaxshi tanigan odamlaringizni tasvirlang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
XARAKTER SIFATLARI.

  ⚠ Bu sifatlar 'What is he LIKE?'
  savoliga javob beradi (tashqi qiyofa
  emas!).

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Tom is very honest. He never tells lies.'

  ⚠ Qolip: ISM + is (very) + SIFAT.
     Keyin SABAB gapi.


⚠ IJOBIY VA SALBIY:

  IJOBIY:  honest, loyal, imaginative,
           sociable, talkative*
  SALBIY:  jealous, mean
  BETARAF: shy

  * 'talkative' vaziyatga qarab ijobiy
    ham, salbiy ham bo'lishi mumkin.


⚠ ADAShTIRMANG - 'MEAN':

  'mean' (sifat) = xasis, ziqna
  'mean' (fe'l) = anglatmoq

  ⚠ AQShda 'mean' = qo'pol, yomon.
  Britaniyada esa asosan XASIS.

  ⚠ Betdagi 15-mashq jadvalida 'mean'
  ikki marta uchraydi (blue va black).


⚠ 'SHY' va 'QUIET':

  shy = uyatchan (odamlardan tortinadi)
  quiet = kamgap (shunchaki ko'p
     gapirmaydi)


⚠ 'TO TELL A LIE' va 'TO SAY':

  'to tell a lie' = yolg'on gapirmoq
  ⚠ 'to say a lie' - XATO!

  'tell' bilan: tell a lie, tell the truth,
     tell a story, tell the time


⚠ 'TO BETRAY':

  = xiyonat qilmoq, sotmoq.
  'loyal' (sodiq) sifatining aksi.

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobda bu juftlik STRELKA bilan
ko'rsatilgan - namuna.

⚠ 'to TELL a lie' - 'to say' EMAS!
⚠ Namuna gap: 'Tom is very honest.
He never tells lies.'

pairs.right: feel angry about not having what others have
pairs.rightUz: boshqalarda bor narsa o'zida yo'qligidan g'azablanadi
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'jealous OF sb' - predlog 'of'.

⚠ 15-mashq jadvalida 'green' rangi
'jealous' bilan bog'langan - inglizchada
hasad YAShIL rang bilan bog'lanadi.

⚠ 'to talk' + -ATIVE = gapirishga moyil.

⚠ 'to stop DOING sth' = qilishni to'xtatmoq.
'to stop TO DO sth' = qilish uchun to'xtamoq -
butunlay boshqa ma'no!

⚠ 'shy' = uyatchan (odamlardan tortinadi).
'quiet' = kamgap (shunchaki jim).

⚠ 'talkative' ning aksi.

⚠ 'mean' (sifat) = XASIS.
'mean' (fe'l) = anglatmoq. Adashtirmang!

⚠ 'to hate' dan keyin -ING: 'hate SPENDING'.
⚠ 'generous' (saxovatli) ning aksi.

⚠ 'to betray' = xiyonat qilmoq, sotmoq.
⚠ 'loyal TO sb' - predlog 'to'.

pairs.right: able to think of new ideas
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'imagination' (tasavvur) → 'imaginative'.

⚠ 'to think OF' = o'ylab topmoq.
'to think ABOUT' = ... haqida o'ylamoq.

⚠ 'society' (jamiyat) → 'sociable'.
⚠ 'to talk TO sb' - predlog 'to'.

⚠ 'shy' ning aksi.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Qaysi sifat rangga MOS KELMASLIGI faqat audiodan eshitiladi - kitob bilan birga keladigan yozuv kerak.
exercises.instructionEn: Listen and cross out the adjective which does not match the colour.
exercises.instructionUz: Eshiting va rangga mos kelmaydigan sifatning ustiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SEVIMLI RANG VA XARAKTER JADVALI.

  Jadval sarlavhasi: 'YOUR FAVOURITE
  COLOUR & YOUR CHARACTER'

  ⚠ Har rangda UChTA sifat berilgan,
  ulardan BITTASI ortiqcha. Qaysi biri
  ortiqchaligi FAQAT AUDIODA aytiladi.

  * ⚠ red: brave, energetic, happy - qaysi
    biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ blue: kind, calm, mean - qaysi biri
    ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ green: jealous, sociable, lazy - qaysi
    biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ black: mean, happy, dishonest - qaysi
    biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ purple: imaginative, loyal, shy - qaysi
    biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ yellow: funny, serious, warm-hearted -
    qaysi biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)
  * ⚠ white: honest, sociable, lazy - qaysi
    biri ortiqcha? (audiodan)


⚠ SIFATLARNING MA'NOSI:

  brave       - jasur
  energetic   - g'ayratli
  happy       - baxtli
  kind        - mehribon
  calm        - vazmin, xotirjam
  mean        - xasis
  jealous     - hasadgo'y
  sociable    - kirishimli
  lazy        - dangasa
  dishonest   - insofsiz
  imaginative - tasavvuri boy
  loyal       - sodiq
  shy         - uyatchan
  funny       - hazilkash
  serious     - jiddiy
  warm-hearted- ochiqko'ngil
  honest      - halol


⚠ INKOR QO'ShIMChASI 'DIS-':

  honest → dishonest (insofsiz)
  ⚠ Jadvalda ikkalasi ham bor:
  'honest' (white) va 'dishonest' (black).


⚠ 15b MAShQI (audiosiz ham bajariladi):

  'Ask your friend what his/her favourite
   colour is, then use the table on the
   left to talk about his/her character.'

  Namuna: 'Susan's favourite colour is ...
  which means she is probably ... and ... .'

  ⚠ 'which means' = bu shuni anglatadiki.
  ⚠ 'probably' = ehtimol - fikrni
  YUMShATADI (chunki bu shunchaki o'yin).

points.noteUz:
⚠ Qaysi sifat ortiqchaligi AUDIODAN.

⚠ 'brave' = jasur; 'energetic' = g'ayratli
('energy' so'zidan).

⚠ Qaysi sifat ortiqchaligi AUDIODAN.

⚠ 'calm' - 'l' harfi O'QILMAYDI: 'kam'.
⚠ 'mean' = xasis (fe'l 'anglatmoq' emas).

⚠ Qaysi sifat ortiqchaligi AUDIODAN.

⚠ Inglizchada hasad YAShIL rang bilan
bog'lanadi: 'green with envy'.

⚠ Qaysi sifat ortiqchaligi AUDIODAN.

⚠ 'dishonest' = 'honest' + inkor 'DIS-'.

⚠ Qaysi sifat ortiqchaligi AUDIODAN.

⚠ 'purple' - qadimda shohlar rangi bo'lgan.

⚠ Qaysi sifat ortiqchaligi AUDIODAN.

⚠ 'funny' va 'serious' bir-biriga QARAMA-QARShI -
ikkalasi bir rangga mos kelishi qiyin.

⚠ Qaysi sifat ortiqchaligi AUDIODAN.

⚠ Oq rang tozalik va halollik ramzi.

points.en: Susan's favourite colour is ... which means she is probably ... and ... .
points.uz: Syuzanning sevimli rangi ... , bu esa uning ehtimol ... va ... ekanini anglatadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 15b mashqining namunasi - AUDIOSIZ ham
bajariladi.

⚠ 'which means' = bu shuni anglatadiki.
⚠ 'probably' fikrni YUMShATADI.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article in Ex. 8 again and take notes under these headings. Then, look at your notes and talk about Thailand and its people.
exercises.instructionUz: 8-mashqdagi maqolani qayta o'qing va shu sarlavhalar ostida qayd oling. So'ng qaydlaringizga qarab Tailand va uning xalqi haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYD OLIB GAPIRISh.

  ⚠ Bu usul 'note-taking' deb ataladi.
  Matnni yodlash EMAS - kalit so'zlarni
  yozib, ularga qarab O'Z GAPINGIZ bilan
  aytish.

  ⚠ Bu ilovaning ham asosiy g'oyasi:
  yodlangan gap emas, O'ZI TUZGAN gap
  esda qoladi.


OLTI SARLAVHA VA MATNDAGI JAVOBLAR
bandlarda berilgan.


⚠ 'A DWELLING':

  = turar joy, yashash joyi.
  ⚠ Rasmiy so'z ('to dwell' = yashamoq).
  Oddiy nutqda 'a home' yoki 'a house'.


⚠ 'FREE-TIME ACTIVITIES':

  = bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari.
  ⚠ 'free time' (ot) - AJRATIB.
  ⚠ 'free-time activities' (sifat) -
  DEFIS bilan.


⚠ QAYDNI QANDAY OLISh:

  To'liq gap YoZMANG - faqat kalit so'z:
     Place: SE Asia, south of China
     People: short, delicate features

  ⚠ Qayd qancha qisqa bo'lsa, gapirganda
  shuncha ERKIN bo'lasiz.

black hair, dark eyes, light brown skin.

strong wills, proud of their history.

village consists of wooden houses, a school and

⚠ 'a dwelling' = turar joy (rasmiy so'z).

fish in the rivers; the women plant the crops.

⚠ Ya'ni asosan farmers va fishermen.

soups, noodles; rice with meals; a lot of
strong spices.

exercises.instructionEn: How many people are there in your family? What does each person look like? What is each person like?
exercises.instructionUz: Oilangizda necha kishi bor? Har bir odam qanday ko'rinadi? Har biri qanday odam?
exercises.explanationUz:
O'Z OILANGIZ HAQIDA GAPIRISh.

  ⚠ Bu betdagi HAMMA so'z shu yerda
  ishlatiladi: 12-mashq jadvali (tashqi
  qiyofa) va 14-mashq sifatlari (xarakter).


⚠ UChTA SAVOL - UChTA BOShQA JAVOB:

  'How many people are there in your
   family?'
     → 'There are five people in my family.'

  'What does he look like?'  (TAShQI)
     → 'He is tall and well-built with
        short dark hair.'

  'What is he like?'  (XARAKTER)
     → 'He is kind and very generous.'

  ⚠ Ikkinchi va uchinchi savolni
  ADAShTIRMANG - bu eng ko'p qilinadigan
  xato.


⚠ 'THERE ARE ... PEOPLE':

  'people' - KO'PLIK ot, shuning uchun
  'there ARE' ('there is' EMAS).

  ⚠ 'How many' + KO'PLIK ot.
  ⚠ 'How much' + sanalmaydigan ot.


⚠ OILA A'ZOLARI:

  parents   - ota-ona
  a father  - ota
  a mother  - ona
  a brother - aka/uka
  a sister  - opa/singil
  a son     - o'g'il
  a daughter- qiz
  grandparents - buvi-bobo

  ⚠ Inglizchada aka va uka BIR XIL
  ('a brother'). Farqlash uchun:
  'my older brother' / 'my younger
  brother'.

items.en: How many people are there in your family?
items.answerEn: There are five people in my family: my father, my mother, my two brothers and me.
items.answerUz: Oilamizda besh kishi: dadam, oyim, ikki akam va men.

items.en: What does your father look like?
items.answerEn: He is tall and well-built with short dark hair and brown eyes. He has got a moustache.
items.answerUz: U baland bo'yli va baquvvat, sochi kalta va qora, ko'zlari jigarrang. Uning mo'ylovi bor.

items.answerEn: He is honest and generous. He is also very calm.
items.answerUz: U halol va saxovatli. Yana juda vazmin.

items.en: What does your mother look like?
items.answerEn: She is of medium height and slim with long straight hair.
items.answerUz: U o'rtacha bo'yli va nozik, sochi uzun va tekis.

items.answerEn: She is kind and sociable. She is never mean.
items.answerUz: U mehribon va kirishimli. Hech qachon xasis emas.

patterns.formula: What does he/she look like? - He/She is [bo'y] and [gavda] with [soch/ko'z].
patterns.exampleEn: What does he look like? - He is tall and slim with short dark hair.
patterns.exampleUz: U qanday ko'rinadi? - U baland bo'yli va nozik, sochi kalta va qora.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ TAShQI QIYoFA savoli.
⚠ 'with' bilan soch va ko'z qo'shiladi.

patterns.formula: What is he/she like? - He/She is [xarakter sifati].
patterns.exampleEn: What is he like? - He is honest and generous.
patterns.exampleUz: U qanday odam? - U halol va saxovatli.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ XARAKTER savoli. 'look' YO'Q!
⚠ Bu ikki savolni adashtirish - eng ko'p
qilinadigan xato.

patterns.exampleEn: Tom is very honest. He never tells lies.
patterns.exampleUz: Tom juda halol. U hech qachon yolg'on gapirmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 14-mashqning namunasi: SIFAT + SABAB.
⚠ 'to TELL a lie' - 'to say' EMAS.

patterns.exampleEn: The Japanese are well known for their hospitality.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'the' + millat = butun xalq, fe'l KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'known FOR' - predlog 'for'.

patterns.formula: Has he/she got [nima]? - Yes, he/she has. / No, he/she hasn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Has he got a beard? - Yes, he has.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Qisqa javobda savoldagi FE'L takrorlanadi.
⚠ Tasdiq javobda qisqartma ishlatilmaydi.

wordFormation.introUz: Xarakter sifatlari - hammasi otdan yoki fe'ldan yasalgan.
